criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. In H1, the targeted Olônne-18 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down), while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, 71 are targeted-only, and the control-overlap fraction is 40/111 = 0.360. Because 40 of 111 targeted DE genes also change in the independent untargeted control, a substantial portion of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. Genomic context is permissive on the two computable GENCODE v36 criteria: the candidate does not overlap any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp (>50 kb), with the nearest gene-body interval gap 60,769 bp (TXNL1). However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label is warranted. The qPCR endpoint in H1 shows near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) across 5 replicates, but no exclusion threshold is defined and significance alone is not a safety or causality claim. H9 is a separate experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here. GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. {"conclusion": "The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. In H1, the targeted Olônne-18 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down), while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, 71 are targeted-only, and the control-overlap fraction is 40/111 = 0.360. Because 40 of 111 targeted DE genes also change in the independent untargeted control, a substantial portion of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. Genomic context is permissive on the two computable GENCODE v36 criteria: the candidate does not overlap any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp (>50 kb), with the nearest gene-body interval gap 60,769 bp (TXNL1). However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label is warranted. proposal.conclusion: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. In H1, the targeted Olônne-18 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down), while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, 71 are targeted-only, and the control-overlap fraction is 40/111 = 0.360. Because 40 of 111 targeted DE genes also change in the independent untargeted control, a substantial portion of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. Genomic context is permissive on the two computable GENCODE v36 criteria: the candidate does not overlap any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp (>50 kb), with the nearest gene-body interval gap 60,769 bp (TXNL1). However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label is warranted. The qPCR endpoint in H1 shows near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) across 5 replicates, but no exclusion threshold is defined and significance alone is not a safety or causality claim. H9 is a separate experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here. GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.

DHS hypersensitivity clusters plus/minus 2 kb (ENCFF503GCK with assembly provenance) are not ingested, so outside_dhs_buffer is incomplete.
Versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions and the original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced, so outside_ultraconserved_regions is incomplete.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 evidence does not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) and the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 40 genes are shared (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360), leaving 71 targeted-only DE genes. The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene-body interval gap is 60,769 bp (TXNL1), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp. Of the 111 targeted DE genes, 103 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the required cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region criteria remain unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and the exclusion decision is not justified by available evidence. This is a publication-derived shortlist in H1; H9 is a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint.

raw_model_proposal.conclusion: The H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 evidence does not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) and the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 40 genes are shared (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360), leaving 71 targeted-only DE genes. The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene-body interval gap is 60,769 bp (TXNL1), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp. Of the 111 targeted DE genes, 103 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the required cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region criteria remain unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and the exclusion decision is not justified by available evidence. This is a publication-derived shortlist in H1; H9 is a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint.
unresolved_questions: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold exists to convert these H1 expression changes into an exclusion decision.
Required cancer-gene (COSMIC v92 CGC), DHS-buffer (ENCFF503GCK) and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so the aggregate screen cannot be completed.
Whether the 40 shared DE genes reflect construct-independent background variation or a shared response is unresolved; overlap cannot establish causality.
Eight targeted DE identifiers map to noncanonical/alt contigs and remain unmapped, so proximity claims cover only 103 of 111 DE genes.
H9 results are a separate cell context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint.
The qPCR nearest-gene endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) provides replicate means but no exclusion threshold.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

Read the named criteria and their parameters. Report all required missing criteria, including unavailable cancer-gene/regulatory evidence. Never infer an overall pass from the available subset.

The nearest_gene_expression qPCR endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) likewise has exclusion_threshold = null. H9 results are a separate cell context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint. proposal.conclusion: The H1 numerical evidence does not justify excluding candidate olonne-18, and it also does not establish that the region is safe. In H1, the targeted clone shows 111 significant DE genes (54 up, 57 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while an independent untargeted H1 culture versus the same reference shows 260 significant DE genes (194 up, 66 down) — i.e. the untargeted control contrast has 149 more qualifying genes than the targeted contrast. The two sets share only 40 genes (40/111 = 0.360 of targeted; 40/260 = 0.154 of control; Jaccard 40/331 = 0.121), all 40 in the same direction, leaving 71 targeted-only and 220 control-only genes. Because substantial DE occurs without targeting, the targeted DE count alone cannot be attributed to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or proximity threshold in the supplied criteria establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Nearest-gene qPCR in H1 is essentially null (MAGI3 -0.00765, TXNL1 -0.06707, ZNRF4 +0.03753 mean log2FC, 5 replicates). Genomic proximity of mapped DE genes is large (nearest same-chromosome DE gene TTC39C at 32,399,165 bp nearest-reference-base distance; GREB1L 35,009,358 bp; AP005119.1 55,176,833 bp), but proximity/distance cannot establish or exclude cis regulation, causality or safety. The required annotation criteria (outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance, lncrna_distance) were not computed by the selected tools and remain incomplete, as do cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions (unavailable). Aggregate status: incomplete, not pass and not fail. H9 evidence is a separate experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here.
unresolved_questions: Do the GENCODE v36 criteria distances hold for olonne-18: outside_gene_body overlap_count, tss_distance >50000 bp, mirna_distance >300000 bp, lncrna_distance >100000 bp? These were not computed by the selected tools and remain incomplete.
cancer_gene_distance (>300000 bp) is unresolved: COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census data/licensing unavailable; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
outside_dhs_buffer (ENCFF503GCK ±2 kb) is unresolved: track not ingested.
outside_ultraconserved_regions is unresolved: versioned GRCh38 source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover not reproduced.
What is the full measured-gene denominator? Supplied tables are significant-only, so no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects is possible.
8 of 111 targeted DE identifiers (e.g. TAS2R19, PRH2, MUC20, UPK3B, TRIM69) map to noncanonical CHR_HSCHR contigs and were unmapped, so proximity claims cover only the 103 mapped genes.
CASP9 is in the targeting construct; RNA-seq counts do not distinguish construct from endogenous transcription.
Whether any targeted-only DE gene is cis-linked to the candidate region is untested; distance alone cannot resolve this.
limitations: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety; no global safe label is assigned.
Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality.
Expression tables are significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe; absence of a row is not a negative biological result.
Counts were recomputed from published tables; DEseq2 was not rerun from sequencing reads.
GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.
H9 is a different experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence was used.

Gene-body and transcription-start distances are distinct metrics; the criteria TSS/gene-body distances were not computed here, and the reported proximity values are distances to DE gene spans, not to TSSs.
Unmapped and noncanonical source identifiers remain visible and may limit proximity claims.
Only the publication-derived shortlist was investigated; no new whole-genome search.
Aggregate criteria status is incomplete because required evidence is missing; individual failures would remain visible if computed.

tasks.question: Do these measured expression changes justify excluding this candidate region?
tasks.completion_condition: Persist exact evidence-linked results, distinguish measured facts from interpretation, and retain unresolved questions.
tasks.instructions: Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. In H1, the targeted Olônne-18 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down), while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, 71 are targeted-only, and the control-overlap fraction is 40/111 = 0.360. Because 40 of 111 targeted DE genes also change in the independent untargeted control, a substantial portion of the targeted DE signal is not unique to the targeted clone, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. Genomic context is permissive on the two computable GENCODE v36 criteria: the candidate does not overlap any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp (>50 kb), with the nearest gene-body interval gap 60,769 bp (TXNL1). However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label is warranted. The qPCR endpoint in H1 shows near-zero mean log2 fold changes for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) across 5 replicates, but no exclusion threshold is defined and significance alone is not a safety or causality claim. H9 is a separate experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here. GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.

DHS hypersensitivity clusters plus/minus 2 kb (ENCFF503GCK with assembly provenance) are not ingested, so outside_dhs_buffer is incomplete.
Versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions and the original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced, so outside_ultraconserved_regions is incomplete.

distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label is warranted. messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 evidence does not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) and the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 40 genes are shared (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360), leaving 71 targeted-only DE genes. The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene-body interval gap is 60,769 bp (TXNL1), and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp. Of the 111 targeted DE genes, 103 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the required cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region criteria remain unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and the exclusion decision is not justified by available evidence. This is a publication-derived shortlist in H1; H9 is a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

input_contract.expression_tables: significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or all measured genes
input_contract.gene_unit: unique versioned Ensembl gene identifier; version-stripped counts also reported
input_contract.comparison: targeted clone or independent untargeted culture versus reference untargeted cells of same H1/H9 context
input_contract.h9_policy: Separate biological context; no automatic generalization to H1
input_contract.interpretive_conclusions: Excluded from worker inputs; only tables, methods metadata and annotations are provided

limitations: Publication-derived shortlist; no new whole-genome search.
GRCh38 reference is not a personalized H1 genome.
GENCODE v36 is a new versioned annotation analysis.
Required cancer-gene and regulatory exclusion evidence is unavailable.

coverage.completeness_definition: All overlapping rows from both frozen UCSC v36 transcript tables; canonical chromosomes only.

annotation.analysis_note: New GENCODE v36 analysis; not an exact reproduction of the publication annotation pipeline.

provenance.source: Frozen source catalog; original sequence and annotation hashes retained inside reference_assets.

limitations: Runtime checkpoints are separate from application acceptance transactions.
Genome base counts are not model token counts.
Original experimental workbooks remain external immutable artifacts identified by their recorded URLs and byte hashes.
